items.title: The LHC just ruled out another hiding place for quantum black holes

items.title: One of America’s largest reservoirs just hit a record low

Federal officials have taken emergency steps to stabilize Lake Powell, including sending in water from another reservoir and reducing releases downstream.

items.title: This emerging treatment could help people avoid knee replacement surgery

items.title: The end of humanity? What would happen if the Yellowstone supervolcano erupted now
items.summary_raw: A Yellowstone super-eruption would begin not with a sudden surprise, but with weeks of increasingly alarming warning signs such as migrating earthquake swarms, rapid ground uplift, changing geysers, and rising volcanic gases. In a worst-case scenario, those signals could culminate in a VEI 8 eruption that blasts ash tens of kilometers into the atmosphere, unleashes deadly pyroclastic flows, buries parts of the western United States in ash, and cripples transportation, electricity, water systems, agriculture, and communications across much of North America.
